items.title: /U P D A T E - Unifor/
items.summary: 800 workers at Amazon's YVR2 fulfilment centre are now covered by a binding collective agreement after an independent arbitrator set its terms on Nov. 13, 2026. The agreement is the first for Amazon workers anywhere in North America and includes wage increases bringing hourly rates to $29 by the end of the agreement, enhanced severance protections of up to 18 weeks, and an additional week of vacation for workers with 10 years of service.
